reviews.title: Intervals Pro has become my 95% fitness app. Replaced all but Apple, occasionally.
reviews.text: When I started a few years ago, I was all HIIT and this was then and is now the best for that. But Intervals Pro is really the Swiss Army Knife of Fitness apps so I have replaced other apps because it can do all phases of my fitness from hourly gym/fitness center workouts (rowing, treadmill, recumbent bike, and every strength machine and equipment you could name).  Now it also has become my walking and running app. Yes, this is better than Apple in this as it has auto-stop for city walks/runs with stop lights. I’d be lost now without this app.

reviews.title: Marathon Maniac 81
reviews.text:
Great app for anyone using the Galloway walk-run method of running on an Apple Watch! Can easily be set up, works great with wireless headphones, and no need to carry the phone. I checked and tried every Apple Watch App and this one is the clear winner! 
New comments(12/5/21): best customer service anywhere!  The app is easy to use, the screens on the Apple Watch are easy to read, and the information provided is fantastic!  In over 40 years of running this is the best!  And it keeps getting better…constant improvements!  Still using this app with 99 marathons!  Couldn’t keep going without this app.  Simply the best!  And top notch customer service as  well!

reviews.title: Great for HIGH INTENSITY INTERVAL TRAINING (HIIT)
reviews.text: HIIT is the way to go for fitness for the maximal benefit for the minimal time, and you can combine short bursts of cardio with short bursts of weight. You can designate intervals and rest periods as you like, designate number of intervals or overall time, and can make anything in your home work with this. I have weights, a few pieces of cardio equipment, and do yoga, so can loop around the equipment I have at home with maximal effort and short rest periods and get an excellent workout in 30 minutes. Works in a gym also if you are willing to move to any available piece of equipment or you work out at an unpopulated time. I paid for the upgrade to do this and it is so worth it. It transfers workouts to Apple Fitness seamlessly. Great motivator if you are starting out again!

reviews.title: Best intervals app
reviews.text: By far the best intervals app out there. Allows the most flexibility.  Voice cues so you can focus on workout. Can mix time and distance.  Better than the interval function on dedicated sports watches I have tried.  On par or better than general workout app at a better price while not trying to sell me shoes that sync with my phone.  Only suggestion I would have is to prove a total at the end of a workout for each interval.  Each interval is listed with stats, but I imagine it wouldn’t be too hard to provide list the totals for the different intervals.

reviews.title: So flexible, So simple
reviews.text:
Intervals Pro is a Swiss army knife of workout apps but is the simplest to use that I’ve found. Just imagine running and hearing just the right amount of coaching about being too fast or too slow for your target pace, keeping you from constantly placing down and seeing just a snapshot of the moment.

You can customize intervals, repetitions, and add in all sorts of odds and ends to your workout. 

You can use this to record an Apple Watch Workout, and you can also use it in the background to coach your pace and let the Workouts app record your data. So flexible I use them both during races!
